newsitem.title: USA: TWA offering special and discount fares.
newsitem.headline: TWA offering special and discount fares.

text.p: Trans World Airlines Inc said Monday it is offering domestic sale fares ranging between $154 and $358 and discounts up to 50 percent off advance purchase structural fares on international flights.
The sale fares are available in more than 160 TWA markets, the carrier said in a statement.
The non-refundable sale fares require a 14-day advance purchase (seven day advance purchase for international flights) and tickets must be bought within three days of reservation.
Travel requires a Saturday night stay to most destinations and other restrictions apply, TWA said.

Tickets must be bought no later than January 24. The first travel date for domestic cities is February 3, and for international cities, January 27. All travel must be completed by May 20 for domestic cities. International travel completion dates vary based on destination, it said.
For example, the New York-San Francisco roundtrip fare is $358 and the New York-Madrid roundtrip fare is $298.
